QuestInfo.name: Bringing a Mirror to Heena
QuestInfo.1: I borrowed a mirror from Sarah who was doing her laundry. I have to take this mirror to Heena.
QuestInfo.2: I borrowed a mirror from Sarah, who was doing her laundry, and brought it back to Heena.
